desc: Derive reverse DP state transitions for continuing a run versus starting a new character run after a valid length-3 run.
Optimize different-letter transitions using per-position minimum/second-minimum values to obtain O(26*n).
Work out suffix-DP reconstruction rules that guarantee lexicographic tie-breaking.
Exhaustively validate the implementation against brute force for short strings, especially lexicographic tie cases and terminal runs.
Verify provided examples and explicit edge cases including lengths below 3, all-equal strings, alternating strings, and transitions near `'a'`/`'z'`; confirm starter-method formatting.
